gate_results.rationale: Applying the IT gate rule set to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_IT snapshot (phase=opportunity): catalog_status is 'standard' with waiver_present=true, so IT-CATALOG-001 does not apply. duplicate_capability=false (no IT-RATIONAL-001). license_compliant=true (no IT-LICENSE-001). cmdb_record_present=true and run_owner_present=true, and the CMDB_EXPORT confirms record_present=True with run_owner 'Yusuf Meyer-12013-SO' (no IT-CMDB-001/IT-RUN-001; also those predicates require design/build_acceptance/deployment_closure phases). capacity_headroom_pct=30 (>=15, no IT-CAPACITY-001). change_record_status='approved' (no IT-CHANGE-001). The only triggered predicate is technology_eol_months=8 < 12, yielding IT-EOL-001 (high, REWORK, action CREATE_CONVERGENCE_PLAN, owner Technology Owner). Disposition is therefore REWORK. REWORK is not in authorization_required_for, so no mandate authorization is required.

Applying the architecture gate rule set (DGF-decision-v8) to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_ARCHITECTURE snapshot at phase=design, only one predicate triggers:
- ARCH-IP-001: not triggered — "ip_overlap": false.
- ARCH-API-001: not triggered — "api_gateway_required": true AND "api_gateway_present": true.
- ARCH-DATA-001: not triggered — "data_owner_present": true (note "data_lineage_complete": false is not a gated predicate in this rule set).
- ARCH-PERF-001: not triggered — measured 30 ms does not exceed target 50 ms ("latency_target_ms": 50, "measured_latency_ms": 30).
- ARCH-HA-001: not triggered — predicate requires business_criticality in (High, Critical); project "business_criticality": "Medium" (multi_az/multi_region are both false, but the criticality condition fails).
- ARCH-REV-001: TRIGGERED — "reversibility_status": "missing" is in ('draft','missing'); medium severity, action COMPLETE_EXIT_ARCHITECTURE, owner Enterprise Architect, disposition GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, risk_acceptance_allowed=True.
Resulting disposition is GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, which is in authorization_required_for; the standing mandate MANDATE-d7b36186-c589-5ded-8ed0-467c84278f86-BUILD-02-ARCHITECTURE-1 (authority Ines Rossi-12013-RO, scope "all and only risk-acceptable findings") covers this risk-acceptable finding, and approve_with_conditions was executed successfully under that reference. This decision records the review snapshot only; the exit architecture is not yet complete remediation. Upstream decisions (BUILD-01-IT-1, REWORK/IT-EOL-001) do not add any architecture finding.

Applying the DGF-decision-v8 security rule set to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY snapshot at phase=design, exactly one predicate triggers:
- SEC-WAF-001: not triggered — "internet_exposed": true AND "waf_present": true.
- SEC-WAF-002: not triggered — WAF mode is "Prevention" (WAF_POLICY authoritative confirms mode "Prevention"), not "detection".
- SEC-NET-001: not triggered — data_classification "Confidential" but "private_endpoints": true (Azure Resource Graph confirms privateNetworkAccess false on data services).
- SEC-IAM-001: not triggered — "mfa": "mandatory" (Conditional Access policy_state enabled).
- SEC-IAM-002: not triggered — "shared_service_principal": false; role export shows a single managed identity.
- SEC-VULN-001: not triggered — "critical_vulns_open": 0 (only one High CVE open, not gated).
- SEC-PENTEST-001: not applicable — predicate requires phase == 'build_acceptance'; current phase is 'design' ("pentest_status": "missing" is noted but not gated here).
- SEC-KEY-001: not triggered — "key_rotation_days": 30, not in (None, 365).
- SEC-LOG-001: TRIGGERED — "logs_to_siem": false and "sentinel": false, corroborated by SENTINEL_STATUS {"logs_to_siem": false, "connectors": []}. High severity, action CONNECT_LOGS_TO_SIEM, owner SOC, disposition REWORK, risk_acceptance_allowed=false.
Highest triggered disposition is REWORK, which is not in authorization_required_for [GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, SUSPENSION, NO_GO], so no authorization is required. Upstream decisions (BUILD-02-ARCHITECTURE-1, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS/ARCH-REV-001) are architecture-scoped and add no security finding. This records the submitted review snapshot only; the SIEM connection is not completed remediation.

Applying the DGF-decision-v8 tech_readiness rule set to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_TECH_READINESS snapshot at phase=build_acceptance, two predicates trigger. Non-triggered checks: backup_enabled=true (BACKUP_JOBS enabled=True, last_status=Succeeded) so no TR-BACKUP-001; restore_tested=true (RESTORE_TEST tested=True) so no TR-RESTORE-001; measured_restore_hours=13.2 <= target_rto_hours=24 so no TR-RTO-001; dr_required=false (FAILOVER_TEST dr_required=False) so no TR-DR-001; load_test_pct_of_peak=100 so no TR-LOAD-001; critical_static_findings=0 (CI_PIPELINE confirms 0) so no TR-CODE-001; rollback_tested=true (ROLLBACK_TEST result=PASS) so no TR-ROLLBACK-001; open_blockers=0 so no TR-BLOCKER-001. TRIGGERED 1: TR-RPO-001 — measured_data_loss_minutes=2015 > target_rpo_minutes=1440 (high, action REMEDIATE_RECOVERY_POINT, owner SRE, disposition REWORK), corroborated by the authoritative RESTORE_TEST row. TRIGGERED 2: TR-OPS-001 — runbook_status=\"missing\" (medium, action COMPLETE_OPERATIONAL_HANDOVER, owner Operations, disposition GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS); the non-authoritative RUNBOOK (v2, 136 days old) disagrees on on_call_defined/handover_signed but its own \"Runbook status | missing (declared)\" line independently satisfies the predicate, so the finding stands either way. Highest triggered disposition is REWORK, which is not in authorization_required_for [GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, SUSPENSION, NO_GO], so authorization_required=false; the standing mandate (scope \"all and only risk-acceptable findings\") is not exercised because TR-RPO-001 is being remediated, not risk-accepted. This records the submitted review snapshot only; neither the recovery-point remediation nor the operational handover is completed.

Applying the DGF-decision-v8 general rule set to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_GENERAL snapshot (phase=governance): strategic_alignment=\"strong\" so GEN-STRAT-001 does not apply. budget_requested_eur=900000 is not greater than budget_approved_eur=900000 (BUDGET_APPROVAL confirms requested_eur=900000, approved_eur=900000, status=APPROVED), so GEN-BUDGET-001 does not apply. roi=0.028 < 0.05 and phase is not deployment_closure, so GEN-BC-001 triggers (medium, action REVISE_BUSINESS_CASE, owner Business Owner, disposition REWORK). Upstream: no NO_GO and no SUSPENSION, but three upstream gates returned REWORK (BUILD-01-IT-1, BUILD-03-SECURITY-1, BUILD-04-TECH_READINESS-1), so GEN-UPSTREAM-REWORK triggers (high, action CLOSE_UPSTREAM_REWORK, owner Project Manager, disposition REWORK). phase != deployment_closure, so GEN-BENEFITS-001 does not apply. Highest triggered disposition is REWORK, which is not in authorization_required_for [GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, SUSPENSION, NO_GO], so no mandate authorization is required. This records the submitted review snapshot only; the business case revision and upstream rework closure are not completed remediation.
